set.body: Figure tiles (MapTileScene.scala ~:95) fade low cells but leave cells without coverage transparent ('known gap'); DESIGN_SPEC §15 says uncovered is never transparent. Add paper-appropriate hatch colours (tokens, figure/paper palette; greyscale-proof legible), draw tile uncovered cells with the shared MissingAssetHatch as one compound shape (no seams), give MapTileScene the theme/paper palette it needs, re-baseline the golden figure once, and add a tile test with a holed grid. Remove the PARITY 'figure tiles … do not hatch' bullet. Owner decision 2026-10-15 (close-out review). Epic bd-01M4R9BYCYAZAPHYSK79MVWHKW.
